architecture_summary: A web application with a React frontend and a Node.js API backed by PostgreSQL.

components.name: frontend
components.description: Student-facing event browsing and registration UI built with React.

components.name: backend
components.description: REST API for events, registrations, and organizer operations built with Node.js.

components.name: database
components.description: PostgreSQL database storing users, events, and registrations.

design_constraints: Prevent duplicate event registrations at the database level.
Only authorized organizers can create or modify events.
API responses must be paginated for large event lists.
